description: Creates a one-on-one AI-led interview on a study and returns the invite link to forward — the guest needs no account. The transcript stays on the study and joins the next analysis run (it never lands in Compass). focusPrompt briefs the interviewer on what to dig into; omitted, it explores the study's territory. May return `needs_confirmation`.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: prism_interviews_create
title: Mint a study interview invite
